item.title: CFIA official tells of threats and harassment that dogged ostrich cull operation
item.description: As Canadian Food Inspection Agency workers prepared for a cull of hundreds of ostriches at a British Columbia farm, they came under a variety of harassment from opponents of the operation, said a senior official with the agency.

item.title: Two teens arrested in connection with First Nation double homicide in northern Quebec
item.description: MONTREAL — Quebec provincial police say two 17-year-old boys have been arrested in a double homicide in a Cree community in northern Quebec. The teens were arrested by a tactical unit Friday in the community of Mistissini around 1 p.m.

item.title: Canadian comedy giant Catherine O'Hara dead at 71
item.description: Canadian comedy giant Catherine O'Hara, known for over-the-top performances in "Schitt's Creek" and "SCTV" and a memorable turn as a stressed-out mom in "Home Alone," has died at 71.

item.title: Conservatives vote to keep Pierre Poilievre as leader after speech in Calgary
item.description: CALGARY — Pierre Poilievre's position as Conservative leader was cemented Friday after 87.4 per cent of delegates voted in a mandatory leadership review to keep him at the helm of their party.

item.title: At least 200 killed in coltan mine collapse in eastern Congo, rebel authorities say
item.description: GOMA, Congo (AP) — At least 200 people were killed earlier this week when a landslide collapsed several mines at a major coltan mining site in eastern Congo, rebel authorities said Saturday.
